nodes.title: Laurent polynomials

nodes.summary: For a Laurent polynomial `f = ∑ c_u x^u`, the tropical term `val(c_u) + u · w ∈ ℝ ∪ {∞}` at the point `w ∈ ℝⁿ` (Maclagan–Sturmfels, draft 2009, Section 3.1).
nodes.title: Value of one term of a tropical polynomial

nodes.summary: Let `K` be an algebraically closed field with a nontrivial valuation `val : K → ℝ ∪ {∞}` and `f = ∑_u c_u x^u` a nonzero Laurent polynomial in `n` variables. The tropical hypersurface of `f`, the set of `w ∈ ℝⁿ` where the minimum `min_u (val(c_u) + u · w)` is attained at least twice, equals the closure in `ℝⁿ` of the set of coordinatewise valuations `(val(y_1), …, val(y_n))` of the zeros `y ∈ (K^*)ⁿ` of `f`.
nodes.title: Kapranov's theorem

nodes.summary: The set of `w ∈ ℝⁿ` at which the minimum `trop(f)(w) = min_{u : c_u ≠ 0} (val(c_u) + u · w)` is attained at least twice (Maclagan–Sturmfels, draft 2009, Definition 3.1.1).
nodes.title: Tropical hypersurface

nodes.summary: Let `K` be an algebraically closed field with a nontrivial valuation `val : K → ℝ ∪ {∞}`, `I` an ideal of Laurent polynomials in `n` variables and `X = V(I)` its variety in the torus `(K^*)ⁿ`. nodes.summary: For an ideal `I` of Laurent polynomials with variety `X = V(I) ⊆ (K^*)ⁿ`, the intersection `trop(X) = ⋂_{f ∈ I} trop(V(f))` of the tropical hypersurfaces of the polynomials in `I` (Maclagan–Sturmfels, draft 2009, Definition 3.2.1, equation (3.1)). can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
